description: Canoe-body hull resistance from the vendored Python-VPP (HydroMod._get_Rr + HydroMod._get_Rv, Yacht built with App=[] so no keel, bulb or rudder terms), for the hull at the sailing displacement. Reference for the core ORC hull resistance model.
method: Inputs from hull_hydro.json conditions.sailing.result: Lwl, canoe_volume, Bwl, Tc, wetted_area_canoe and displacement_kg (Python-VPP's Mass).
Python-VPP constants: rho 1025 kg/m^3, mu 1.19e-3 Pa s (nu = mu / rho), g 9.81 m/s^2, roughness 0.
Speed V = Fn sqrt(g Lwl), Python-VPP taking LSM = Lwl.

Rr = ORCi drag surface (Fn, LVR = Lwl / canoe_volume^(1/3), BTR = Bwl / Tc), linear in each axis with a zero row at Fn 0, times Mass g 1e-3; times 1 + 0.0004 (heel_deg - 30)^2 at heel of 30 deg or more.
Rv = 0.5 rho V^2 wetted_area_canoe Cf 1.05, Cf = 0.066 / (log10 Re - 2.03)^2, Re = 0.85 V Lwl / nu.

deviations_from_orc_2023.orc_2023: Fn on the dynamic length L, a Froude-number-dependent mix of RRLSM1, RRLSM4 and RRLSM6 (section 6.3.1, Composite Length Calculation); viscous Re on 0.85 LSM1 (eq. 6.2).
deviations_from_orc_2023.here: Lwl at the sailing displacement stands in for every one of them, for Fn, LVR and the viscous Reynolds number, unless the dossier supplies conditions.sailing.orc lsm1/lsm4/lsm6.

deviations_from_orc_2023.orc_2023: Effective beam over effective hull depth, depth-attenuated integrals (section 4, Beam Depth Ratio).
deviations_from_orc_2023.here: Bwl / Tc of the canoe body at the sailing displacement, unless the dossier supplies conditions.sailing.orc btr_effective or a heeled BTR table.

deviations_from_orc_2023.orc_2023: Canoe-body Rr is the 50:50 mean of the drag surfaces and a 14-input neural network (section 6.3).
deviations_from_orc_2023.here: Drag surfaces only; the neural-network half is not implemented.

deviations_from_orc_2023.orc_2023: No immersed-rail multiplier on Rr; heel enters through heeled hydrostatics.
deviations_from_orc_2023.here: Python-VPP's immersed-rail factor 1 + 0.0004 (phi_deg - 30)^2 for heel above 30 deg, 1 otherwise. Not in the ORC 2023 documentation; kept because the Python-VPP downwind target uses it. Upright hydrostatics otherwise.

deviations_from_orc_2023.orc_2023: LVR outside 3..9 and BTR outside 2.5..9 default to the closest point of the surface; Fn outside 0.125..0.7 is extrapolated.
deviations_from_orc_2023.here: Same in the core model (LVR and BTR clamped and flagged, Fn extrapolated linearly, with a zero row at Fn 0). Python-VPP instead extrapolates linearly in all three axes; the two agree whenever LVR and BTR are inside the grid, as they are for this boat.

tow.description: Upright, zero-leeway tow resistance at fixed speeds of the canoe body with Python-VPP's Keel and Rudder (the trapezoids run_pyvpp.py builds), same hull inputs as `points`. total_N is Python-VPP's _get_Rr + _get_Rv + _get_Ri at zero leeway, so induced_N is zero.
method: Speed V = speed_kn * 0.514444 m/s; Fn = V / sqrt(g Lwl).
Keel residuary: Python-VPP's rrk curve at Fn (clamped to 0..0.6) times the keel volume 0.666 c_mean 1.2 span, rho g 1e-3. The rudder has none.
Appendage viscous: ORC 6.1.2 strips, 0.5 rho V^2 sum(wsa/5 (Cf_app(c) (1 + k) + dcd)) with wsa = 2 c_mean span and dcd zero at zero side force.
canoe is the remainder of _get_Rr and _get_Rv once the appendage terms are taken out; it equals the canoe-only evaluation.
